hero.headline: Help build the 10th Annual Toy Drive
hero.intro: The Elk Grove Toy Drive Celebration gathers unwrapped toys for children served by local charities — and hosts a joyful evening with Santa photos, dinner, crafts, and entertainment. Sponsors fund the fete. Volunteers make the magic.
hero.subhead: We're looking for directors — one owner per piece of the celebration. Pick the lane you want to lead.
hero.body: We need directors — people who own an outcome, build a small team, and see it through with chair support. Co-chair Ellie King (cPALSs) backs every lane.

volunteer.headline: Volunteer for Toy Drive 2026
volunteer.intro: Interest sign-up for the Sunday, December 6 celebration at District 56. Everyone is waitlisted until we approve. Officer-led groups and individual volunteers are both welcome.
bullets: Pick one or more shifts: Pre (11:30 AM–3:30 PM setup, 4 hr), During (3:30–7:30 guest stations), Cleanup (7:30–9:00 teardown).
Registration is interest only — you stay waitlisted until we approve.
If approved, we email a digital waiver next; arrival and check-in details come closer to December 6.
Unwrapped toys are welcome if you bring them — empty hands are fine too.
volunteer.directorsNote: Looking to lead a lane instead? See open director roles on Team.

steps: Pick one role (or two if they're closely related — we'll talk). See the full list on Team.
Apply on Idealist — name your role, preferred contact method (email, text, or phone), and any events you're already committed to this season.
We'll follow up within a few business days — introduce you to the chairs, share last year's runbooks, and set a first check-in.
apply.idealistFallback: Can't use Idealist? Email contact@elkgrovetoydrive.com with the role name and one sentence on why you're interested.

directorIntro.title: What is a director?
paragraphs: A director is the go-to person for one celebration lane. You don't have to do every task yourself — you own the plan, coordinate vendors and volunteers, and report status to the chairs. Most roles are planning now through December 2026; peak workload is the two weeks before and event day.
Already covered: Event co-chair — Ellie King (cPALSs). The second co-chair seat is open. The chairs hold decision authority for the season; every lane director is open for 2026 recruitment.

14 director roles are open across guest experience, toys & partners, and outreach & production. Member and support roles fill in behind each director. Returning volunteers are welcome to apply — nothing is assumed until confirmed.
notes: Fund the Fete at /fund-the-fete/ is the interactive sponsorship registry — named celebration gifts with slot counts, plus traditional recognition tiers (Friend through Title).
Toy collection for charities is the mission; the celebration evening is how the community gathers and sponsors fund hospitality.
Volunteers Director owns shifts; chairs help cover gaps when a lane is still filling.

sections.title: The celebration
paragraphs: Each December, Community Partners Advocate of Little Saigon Sacramento (cPALSs) hosts the Elk Grove Toy Drive Celebration — a free family evening with Santa photos, dinner, crafts, kids games, entertainment, and the gathering of unwrapped toys for children served by local charities.
Our goal is simple: no child should be without a toy this Christmas. Sponsors fund the hospitality of the evening through Fund the Fete; guests bring unwrapped toys; volunteers make the night run.

sections.title: Where & who
paragraphs: The celebration is at District 56 in Elk Grove (Civic Center Drive) on Sunday, December 6, 2026, from 3:30–7:30 PM.
Toy Drive is a project of cPALSs. Questions: contact@elkgrovetoydrive.com.

charities.headline: Local Charities
charities.lead: We're proud to support local charities to bring smiles to children in our community!
charities.seasonNote: Toys collected at the celebration go to partner charities that serve children in our region. 2026 recipients will be confirmed closer to the event.

partners.name: xHope
partners.mission: Empowers vulnerable children and families in the Sacramento region with hope, love, education, and support — serving foster and adoptive families, youth aging out of care, unsheltered teens, and families in hardship.

partners.name: Dr. Sun Yat-sen Chinese School
partners.mission: Part of SCIFA (Sacramento Chinese of Indochina Friendship Association): preserves language and culture for ethnic Chinese families from Southeast Asia, and runs a Chinese school plus community mutual-aid.

partners.name: Marayah Cares Foundation
partners.mission: Honors Marayah’s memory by helping families facing childhood cancer costs, supporting youth through education and athletics, and protecting neglected or abused animals.

partners.name: Cosumnes Fire Department
partners.mission: Provides fire protection and emergency medical services for Elk Grove and Galt; also runs community holiday outreach such as the Toy Project and Santa & Sirens toy collections.

partners.name: Lac Hong Vietnamese School
partners.mission: Volunteer-run Vietnamese Parent Teacher Association (since 1988) that teaches Vietnamese language and culture to younger generations in the Sacramento area.
